# MDN021 `deprecated-relational-operator`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A relational operator written `.eq.`, `.ne.`, `.lt.`, `.le.`, `.gt.`, `.ge.`.

## Why

The symbolic operators `==`, `/=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` have been standard since Fortran 90 and read
like mathematics. Fixable automatically (`fobis lint --fix`).

## Reported

```fortran
if (a .eq. b .and. c .ge. 0) then
```

## Preferred

```fortran
if (a == b .and. c >= 0) then
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN021] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN021` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD021` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
